title: Two Python Surfaces (Core Runtime vs Tooling/Test)
context: WL-120/WL-136 identified mixed-purpose Python surfaces that increased runtime coupling and slowed decomposition progress.
decision: Ratify two explicit Python surfaces and require command domains to import extracted implementation modules directly (e.g., dag_impl.py, work_stream_impl.py) instead of routing through impl.py where extraction exists.
consequence: Core/runtime paths can be measured and reduced independently, while tooling/test surfaces remain isolated from fast-lane runtime checks. Full detail: docs/reference/ADR-016-two-python-surfaces.md
